Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Under old workings lies {crystal.earth.name}. The foresters' marks point the way, if we can read them.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The sawyer knows the foresters' notches. He can read us the way.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The foresters left posts where the home wood begins. Slow to read, but they don't forget.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The notches point to a stone in the glade between the two woods.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Surveyors marked these walls. Their marks will show the branch we want.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The double cuts lead to the Root Chamber. With luck, we're first.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The tally counts turnings. Follow it and we find where they went.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: {role.keeper_earth.name} waits below with what they took. We get it back there.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Its place is {crystal.earth.tower}. Let's take {crystal.earth.name} home.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Last we heard, {crystal.earth.name} was at {crystal.earth.place}.

Lines.Speaker: odo
Lines.Text: Three short notches, again and again. Somebody wanted us at that glade.

Lines.Speaker: sawyer
Lines.Text: Foresters cut notches as they walk. Three short ones mean stone ahead.

Lines.Speaker: sawyer
Lines.Text: Follow the threes out of the home wood. They end in a glade with a grey stone in it.

Lines.Speaker: sawyer
Lines.Text: Odd stone, that. Nobody stands a stone that square by accident.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Three notches, then three, then three. Every post leans the same way.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: They point between the two woods. There's a glade there.
The sawyer read the foresters' notches: they lead to a stone in a glade between the two woods.
Mira read the foresters' posts at the edge of the home wood. They lean toward the glade.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Three cuts and a ring. Surveyors' marks, older than the camps.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The ring is on this slab. Push with me.

Lines.Speaker: odo
Lines.Text: Not a forester's cut. Somebody wanted this found, but only by the right people.
Mira read the boundary stone in the Stonemark Glade and found the stair.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Mind your feet. The stair we came down stays lit, and any of us can lead you back to it.

Lines.Speaker: ivo
Lines.Text: I'm drawing as we go. Left is fallen rock. Right looks worked.

Lines.Speaker: petra
Lines.Text: Cold in here. Nothing's burned in this place for a long while.

Lines.Speaker: nell
Lines.Text: Water's been through these walls. Long gone now.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Double cuts, all pointing up the right-hand branch.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: They were going somewhere they wanted to find again.
Mira read the survey marks in the Old Quarry. The double cuts lead to the Root Chamber.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: There you are. Heavier than it looks.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: The pedestal reads: what was cut from the rock goes home to {crystal.earth.tower}.
Mira took {crystal.earth.name} from its pedestal in the Old Quarry.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Bare. Someone was quicker.

Lines.Speaker: garrick
Lines.Text: Fresh boot marks. Not ours, and not old.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: An Ash tally stick. A notch for every turning they took, and they took the stair down.
The pedestal in the Old Quarry was bare. An Ash tally stick lay beside it.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Five notches, then a cross. Five turnings, then the place they stopped.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Down here, then. Stay close and count with me.
Mira counted the tally's turnings down the old stair to the Tally Vault.

Lines.Speaker: tansy
Lines.Text: Fresh spoil round the hill. They dug in from outside, then barred it behind them.

Lines.Speaker: keeper_earth
Lines.Text: Every stone taken is a notch on my stick. Come to be counted?

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: {role.keeper_earth.name} has seen us. If this goes badly, {volunteer.name} holds the way out. Do we fight?

Lines.Speaker: garrick
Lines.Text: Go. I've had the practice.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Garrick held the passage so we could run. He knew he would.

Lines.Speaker: keeper_earth
Lines.Text: Count's finished. Take it. The bar's off the door, too.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: We have {crystal.earth.name} again. And that door is the Ash cut: a shorter way up.
Mira beat Dolm in the Tally Vault and took {crystal.earth.name} from the Ash altar.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Stone to stone. Hold still, all of you.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: It's lit. Feel that? The ground's settling.

Lines.Speaker: prince
Lines.Text: Green-gold light on the south-west shore. The camp talks of nothing else.

Lines.Speaker: mira
Lines.Text: Garrick should have seen this.
Mira set {crystal.earth.name} in {crystal.earth.tower}. The tower is lit.
